QuestInfo.name: Grako's Request
QuestInfo.0: Grako doesn't look so good. You should talk to her.
QuestInfo.1: It seems Grako of Showa Town is dealing with an upset stomach. You offered to get her some medicine, but all she wanted was some cider. Go and find some cider for Grako.\n\n#t2022002#  #b#c2022002##k/1
QuestInfo.2: You gave Grako the cider she asked for, but it seems she was faking her illness. And now she has the gall to ask you for another favor! Should you trust her?

0.0: Oh my gosh, my stomach hurts like craaaaazy! Could you help me out if you have a minute?

yes.0: Thanks. You know, I just ate and my stomach is killing me. I'm sure a nice bottle of cider would cure it.

no.0: Ugh, my stomach is killing me...

yes.0: Thank you sooo much! Ahh, this is soooo refreshing! You know, you seem like a really nice person! And... I feel bad lying to you. I... don't actually have a stomachache, I just really wanted some cider. Sorry!

item.0: What? You didn't buy it yet? I'm sooo disappointed!
